resources.string: Tasks continue outside this screen. Pause keeps completed phases and verified restored files. Preparing a backup restarts archive creation; an interrupted destination file restarts after verification. Private archives remain until you remove their history entry.
Backups you start will appear here with their progress.
The action failed. Check access and choose the original destination.
Changed or ambiguous files and journals are retained for review. Existing files are not replaced.
Restore access to the same destination, then resume. No missing or inaccessible file implies deletion.
Cancel this task and remove only its unchanged, operation-owned outputs? Changed files remain for review.
